opstruth-chatgpt-plugin.label: OpsTruth for ChatGPT and Codex
opstruth-chatgpt-plugin.event_problem: This surface turns repository verification into a conversational tool while preserving OpsTruth's read-only evidence boundary.
opstruth-chatgpt-plugin.event_cta: Which repository claim would you want ChatGPT to verify instead of trust?
opstruth-chatgpt-plugin.claim_boundary: Plugin/read-only verification framing only; no mutation authority, private-repository access or universal deployment proof.
opstruth-chatgpt-plugin.default_cta: Which repository claim would you want ChatGPT to verify instead of trust?

inventory.title: Chat should not replace evidence
inventory.hook: A confident chat answer is not repository evidence.
inventory.body: The OpsTruth plugin is built to bind claims to repositories, commits, CI, runtime observations and receipts instead of asking users to trust a summary.
inventory.cta: What engineering claim do you most often have to verify manually?

inventory.title: Signed snapshots still need trust context
inventory.hook: A signature proves integrity, not that the underlying outcome is true.
inventory.body: Portable evidence snapshots are useful only when signer trust, freshness, authorisation and subject binding remain separate decisions.
inventory.cta: Which of those checks does your current evidence flow skip?

inventory.title: Verification should stay read-only
inventory.hook: The verifier should not quietly become the repair tool.
inventory.body: Keeping observation separate from mutation makes it easier to know whether a result came from independent evidence or the executor's own claim.
inventory.cta: Would you give your verifier write access to the target?

evidence-explorer.label: Public Decision Intelligence / Evidence Explorer
evidence-explorer.event_problem: The frontend exists to make evidence, entities and decision chains inspectable without weakening the backend truth model.
evidence-explorer.event_cta: What would make a public evidence browser genuinely useful to you?
evidence-explorer.claim_boundary: Frontend/browser framing only; do not imply analyst-grade review tooling or polished public deployment unless separately evidenced.
evidence-explorer.default_cta: What would make a public evidence browser genuinely useful to you?

inventory.title: Evidence needs a browse surface
inventory.hook: Evidence is hard to use if every answer requires reading the raw corpus again.
inventory.body: The Evidence Explorer turns documents, entities, grouped search and decision chains into a read-only browse surface over the Public Decision Intelligence backend.
inventory.cta: Which view would save you the most investigation time?

inventory.title: Decision chains should stay inspectable
inventory.hook: A summary hides the path that produced it.
inventory.body: A useful evidence browser lets you move from a decision chain back to the entities, documents and source-linked details that support it.
inventory.cta: Where do current research tools make that path disappear?

inventory.title: Frontend should not invent backend truth
inventory.hook: A polished UI should not outrun the evidence model behind it.
inventory.body: The explorer is intentionally wired to the backend's real public contract rather than maintaining a second interpretation of the data.
inventory.cta: What truth drift have you seen between backend and dashboard?

oneclick-chatgpt-plugin.label: One Click for ChatGPT
oneclick-chatgpt-plugin.event_problem: The product turns a rough business idea into a structured website handoff while leaving actual project creation to Lovable.
oneclick-chatgpt-plugin.event_cta: What information do you usually forget before asking an AI builder to make a website?
oneclick-chatgpt-plugin.claim_boundary: Initial anonymous handoff only; authenticated saved projects and Full Mode remain roadmap items until reviewed end to end.
oneclick-chatgpt-plugin.default_cta: What information do you usually forget before asking an AI builder to make a website?

inventory.title: A rough idea needs structure before building
inventory.hook: The first website iteration is often expensive because the brief is still vague.
inventory.body: One Click turns the rough business idea into a structured handoff before Lovable creates the project, so the builder starts with more useful context.
inventory.cta: Which part of your website brief is usually missing on day one?

inventory.title: Handoff is different from project creation
inventory.hook: Preparing the brief and building the project are different jobs.
inventory.body: One Click prepares the structured draft; the separately installed Lovable plugin remains responsible for project creation and later code changes.
inventory.cta: Where does your current AI website workflow blur those responsibilities?

inventory.title: Anonymous first can be a feature
inventory.hook: Not every useful first interaction needs an account system.
inventory.body: The initial One Click release keeps the website handoff lightweight and ephemeral instead of pretending saved projects and Full Mode are already available.
inventory.cta: Would you try a useful handoff before creating an account?

lovable-architecture-auditor.label: Lovable Architecture Auditor
lovable-architecture-auditor.claim_boundary: Current £1.99 no-login audit offer and documented manual delivery flow only; no automated-audit or guaranteed-hardening claim.
lovable-architecture-auditor.default_cta: What part of a Lovable project do you understand least after several prompt-driven changes?

inventory.title: Prompt-built projects need architecture visibility
inventory.hook: A Lovable project can work while its architecture becomes hard to explain.
inventory.body: The £1.99 audit offer is designed to map the system, data flow, APIs, permissions, AI usage, pain points and unknowns into a reviewable documentation pack.
inventory.cta: Which part of your Lovable project feels least explainable today?

inventory.title: Unknowns belong in the audit
inventory.hook: An architecture audit is weaker when it pretends every dependency is understood.
inventory.body: I want the output to name unknowns and evidence gaps alongside the system map rather than hide uncertainty behind polished diagrams.
inventory.cta: What question about your project has nobody been able to answer cleanly?

inventory.title: Architecture docs should live with the project
inventory.hook: A handover PDF becomes stale quickly if the project keeps moving.
inventory.body: Delivering the audit into the project's own documentation folder makes it easier for later builders and agents to find the current architecture context.
inventory.cta: Where do your project docs live today?

relay-live-business-engagement.label: Relay Live Business Engagement
relay-live-business-engagement.event_problem: The connector provides bounded API-first discovery and engagement actions with explicit write approval, account admission and activity evidence.
relay-live-business-engagement.event_cta: Which social engagement action would you automate only if the approval and receipt trail were explicit?
relay-live-business-engagement.claim_boundary: Connector/runtime capability framing only; provider actions remain scope-, permission- and tier-dependent and do not imply universal API availability.
relay-live-business-engagement.default_cta: Which social engagement action would you automate only if the approval and receipt trail were explicit?

inventory.title: Live engagement needs an authority boundary
inventory.hook: A social agent should not get permanent permission to do everything just because one reply was approved.
inventory.body: Relay separates discovery, candidate selection, account admission and the exact approved write so live engagement can stay bounded and auditable.
inventory.cta: Which action would you never allow under a blanket approval?

inventory.title: Discovery and execution should be separate
inventory.hook: Finding a conversation is not the same consequence as replying to it.
inventory.body: The connector exposes read surfaces first and only crosses into a provider write when the action, account and target satisfy the live approval contract.
inventory.cta: Does your social automation separate reads from writes?

inventory.title: Ambiguous writes should block retry
inventory.hook: Blind retry is dangerous when a provider may already have accepted the first request.
inventory.body: Activity evidence and idempotency matter because an uncertain write should stop fallback and replay until the external effect is understood.
inventory.cta: How does your current scheduler handle an uncertain provider response?

coding-agent-skills.label: Coding Agent Skills
required_phrases_any: Shared, versioned workflows for evidence-driven coding agents
coding-agent-skills.event_problem: The package turns recurring evidence-driven coding checks into versioned, bounded skills rather than ad-hoc prompts.
coding-agent-skills.event_cta: Which coding-agent check do you keep rebuilding from scratch?
coding-agent-skills.claim_boundary: Safe evidence-producer framing only; no deployment execution, package installation, target mutation or generic orchestration claim.
coding-agent-skills.default_cta: Which coding-agent check do you keep rebuilding from scratch?

inventory.title: Agent workflows should be versioned
inventory.hook: A useful coding-agent workflow should not depend on remembering the right prompt every time.
inventory.body: Coding Agent Skills packages evidence-driven checks like route tracing, environment mapping, API review and deployment preflight into reusable versioned workflows.
inventory.cta: Which check do your agents repeatedly improvise today?

inventory.title: Completion needs an evidence contract
inventory.hook: A command being attempted is not evidence that the job completed.
inventory.body: The shared evidence-pack contract keeps required checks, skipped checks, failures, confidence and unresolved questions visible instead of compressing everything into success/failure.
inventory.cta: What evidence do you require before accepting an agent handoff?

inventory.title: Audit-only should stay audit-only
inventory.hook: A repository scanner should not quietly become a deployment tool.
inventory.body: The skills pack deliberately separates audit-only workflows from action-capable work and leaves orchestration, permissions and scheduling to the caller.
inventory.cta: Where does your tooling blur inspection and mutation?

public-decision-intelligence.label: Public Decision Intelligence
public-decision-intelligence.event_problem: The product transforms large public document releases into traceable decision intelligence while preserving source identity, evidence and revision history.
public-decision-intelligence.event_cta: Which public-document investigation is hardest to reconstruct over time?
public-decision-intelligence.claim_boundary: Current implemented evidence/decision runtime and preview browse surface only; no analyst-grade collaboration or extracted Postgres production claim.
public-decision-intelligence.default_cta: Which public-document investigation is hardest to reconstruct over time?

inventory.title: The truth model is the product
inventory.hook: A chatbot over PDFs is not enough when the question is how a public decision formed.
inventory.body: Public Decision Intelligence keeps documents, citations, entities, events, claims, relationships and decision chains connected so conclusions can be traced back to source evidence.
inventory.cta: Which public decision would you want to inspect as a chain rather than a summary?

inventory.title: Corrections should revise the chain
inventory.hook: New files should be able to change the story without deleting the old evidence path.
inventory.body: The decision model is designed for revision, gap detection and alternative interpretations as new source material arrives.
inventory.cta: How do you currently track when new evidence changes an earlier conclusion?

inventory.title: Real corpus proof matters
inventory.hook: Synthetic fixtures are not enough for an evidence product.
inventory.body: The current runtime has already processed a real corpus into chunks, citations, entities, events, claims, relationships and decision chains, while the public surface remains deliberately in preview.
inventory.cta: What real corpus would you use to pressure-test an evidence system?
